significance: One of the 108 Divya Desams, on the Kaveri near Kumbakonam, where Vishnu is worshipped as Jagathrakshaka, protector of the world; later patronage came from Vijayanagara kings and the Madurai Nayaks.
story: Local tradition links the shrine to Varaha, the boar form in which Vishnu raised the earth goddess Bhumi from the netherworld.
